.github/workflows/limix-site.yml.before:
# Limix Bot website: deploys limix/site to a Cloudflare Worker (static files only) and points limixmedia.com and
# www.limixmedia.com at it. Uses the same CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN secret as limix-cloudflare.yml.
name: Limix Site

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ["limix/site/**"]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
.github/workflows/limix-site.yml.after:
# Limix Bot website: deploys limix/site to a Cloudflare Worker (static files only) and points limixmedia.com and
# www.limixmedia.com at it. Uses the same CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN secret as limix-cloudflare.yml.
name: Limix Site

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      configure_domains:
        description: Reconfigure existing domain bindings
        type: boolean
        default: false
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ["limix/site/**"]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:

.github/workflows/limix-site.yml.before:
- name: deploy the static site
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/site && cp -r limix/site/. /tmp/site/
          cd /tmp/site
          printf '{"name":"limix-site","private":true}' > package.json
          npm install --no-audit --no-fund --no-save --no-package-lock wrangler@4.125.0
          npx wrangler deploy
      - name: point limixmedia.com and www at the site
        run: |
          api=https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4
          auth=(-H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json")
          zone=$(curl -sS "${auth[@]}" "$api/zones?name=limixmedia.com" | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).result?.[0]?.id??""))')
          test -n "$zone" || { echo "::error::Zone limixmedia.com not found for this token"; exit 1; }
          for host in limixmedia.com www.limixmedia.com; do
            # The old record (a Cloudflare Tunnel) is printed before removal so it can be recreated by hand.
            curl -sS "${auth[@]}" "$api/zones/$zone/dns_records?name=$host" | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{for(const r of JSON.parse(s).result??[]) if(["A","AAAA","CNAME"].includes(r.type)) console.log(r.id+" "+r.type+" "+r.content+" proxied="+r.proxied)})' > /tmp/old.txt
.github/workflows/limix-site.yml.after:
- name: deploy the static site
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/site && cp -r limix/site/. /tmp/site/
          cd /tmp/site
          printf '{"name":"limix-site","private":true}' > package.json
          npm install --no-audit --no-fund --no-save --no-package-lock wrangler@4.125.0
          npx wrangler deploy
      - name: point limixmedia.com and www at the site
        if: inputs.configure_domains
        run: |
          api=https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4
          auth=(-H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json")
          zone=$(curl -sS "${auth[@]}" "$api/zones?name=limixmedia.com" | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).result?.[0]?.id??""))')
          test -n "$zone" || { echo "::error::Zone limixmedia.com not found for this token"; exit 1; }
          for host in limixmedia.com www.limixmedia.com; do
            # The old record (a Cloudflare Tunnel) is printed before removal so it can be recreated by hand.
            curl -sS "${auth[@]}" "$api/zones/$zone/dns_records?name=$host" | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{for(const r of JSON.parse(s).result??[]) if(["A","AAAA","CNAME"].includes(r.type)) console.log(r.id+" "+r.type+" "+r.content+" proxied="+r.proxied)})' > /tmp/old.txt

.github/workflows/limix-windows.yml.before:
# Limix Bot (Leox ৹ Limix AI): builds the Windows installer on a real Windows runner, checks that the packaged
# server starts, and publishes a GitHub release whose latest.yml the in-app updater reads.
# Adapted from OpenMausBot's package-win.yml (Apache-2.0). Run it from Actions → "Limix Bot Windows" → Run workflow,
# or push to main (the release tag v<version> is created by the publish step).
name: Limix Bot Windows

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      publish:
        description: "Publish a GitHub release (otherwise only keep the installer as a workflow artifact)"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ["v*"]
    paths-ignore: ["limix/docs/**", "limix/gateway/**", "limix/site/**", ".github/workflows/limix-site.yml", "limix/brand-assets/limix-site.yml", "**/*.md"]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  package:
    name: Windows installer
    runs-on: windows-latest
.github/workflows/limix-windows.yml.after:
# Limix Bot (Leox ৹ Limix AI): builds the Windows installer on a real Windows runner, checks that the packaged
# server starts, and publishes a GitHub release whose latest.yml the in-app updater reads.
# Adapted from OpenMausBot's package-win.yml (Apache-2.0). Run it from Actions → "Limix Bot Windows" → Run workflow,
# or push to main (the release tag v<version> is created by the publish step).
name: Limix Bot Windows

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      publish:
        type: boolean
        required: false
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  package:
    name: Windows installer
    runs-on: windows-latest

.github/workflows/limix-windows.yml.before:
with:
          name: limix-bot-windows
          path: |
            release/*.exe
            release/*.exe.blockmap
            release/latest.yml
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: publish the GitHub release
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || inputs.publish
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          v=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          tag="v$v"
          notes="Limix Bot $v for Windows (Leox ৹ Limix AI). Based on OpenMausBot (Apache-2.0). The installer is not code-signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may show 'Unknown publisher' — choose More info → Run anyway."
          if gh release view "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$tag" release/*.exe release/*.exe.blockmap release/latest.yml --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$tag" release/*.exe release/*.exe.blockmap release/latest.yml --title "Limix Bot $v" --notes "$notes" --target "$GITHUB_SHA"
          fi
.github/workflows/limix-windows.yml.after:
with:
          name: limix-bot-windows
          path: |
            release/*.exe
            release/*.exe.blockmap
            release/latest.yml
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
